findings.evidence: Lines 106-108 and 211-217 contain the same `smul_add, toCircle_add, mul_comm` simp set; `grep -n 'fourier n (x +' mathlib/Mathlib` returns nothing, and `AddCircle.lean:172` only covers `fourier (m + n) x`.
findings.fix: Add one lemma near `qVector`, e.g. `theorem fourier_apply_add (n : ℤ) (x y : AddCircle T) : fourier n (x + y) = fourier n x * fourier n y := by simp [smul_add, toCircle_add]`, and prove `qVector_add_const` and `anisotropyCoeff_map_add` by `simp [fourier_apply_add, ...]` / `Finset.mul_sum` instead of reaching through `toCircle`.
findings.issue: The character identity `fourier n (x + ψ) = fourier n x * fourier n ψ` is never stated; it is re-proved inline twice by unfolding `fourier` to `toCircle` — line 108 `simp [qVector, Finset.mul_sum, smul_add, toCircle_add, mul_comm]` and line 217 `simp [smul_add, toCircle_add, mul_comm]`. Both depend on `fourier_apply` (Mathlib `AddCircle.lean:128`, `@[simp]`) silently rewriting into `toCircle (n • x)`, and on `mul_comm` as an unordered simp rewrite. Mathlib has `fourier_add` for `fourier (m + n) x` but nothing for an additive shift of the argument, so there is no existing lemma covering this.

The subterm `(fourier n).continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable (hφ _)` appears at 270 and 290, `(Complex.continuous_conj.comp (fourier n).continuous)` at 257 and 291, and `Integrable.of_bound ... 1 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by simp)` at 271 and 292.

findings.evidence: Lines 286-287 and 334-335; contrast line 316-318, which already uses `simp only` + `field_simp` + `ring` for the same kind of goal.
findings.fix: Replace both with `simp only [...]` listing the lemmas actually needed, and close with `field_simp; ring` / `ring` so the final step is a decision procedure on a goal of known shape.
findings.issue: Non-terminal full `simp` whose exact output the next tactic must match: line 334 `simp [integral_div, integral_sub hint ..., integral_norm_qVector_sq ...]` followed by a bare `field_simp` as the closer (a normalisation tactic, not a finisher), and line 286 `simp [Finset.card_erase_of_mem, Finset.card_univ, Nat.cast_sub h]` followed by `ring`. Any change to the default simp set leaves a goal the follow-up cannot close, even though the mathematics is unchanged.

summary: Two reusable facts are hidden inside duplicated tactic blocks: the character identity for `fourier` (proved twice by unfolding to `toCircle`) and the boundedness/measurability boilerplate for `fourier n ∘ φ j` (spelled out three times). Two proofs also close through a non-terminal full `simp`.
